body: It literally dives me insane, I go get something to drink and I get kicked from the server. It really has no point at least in Nebula. ;-; Opinions?

title: Remove the AFK plugin?

replies.author: Legoche
replies.body: I think it is to stop players Afking and others not being able to get onto the game because it is full. It should change you to a spectator in my opinion, and after 5 minutes or something
replies.body_tagged: I think it is to stop players Afking and others not being able to get onto the game because it is full. It should change you to a spectator in my opinion, and after 5 minutes or something

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: I'm with the changing to spectators idea, but maybe have the time amount extended a little?
replies.body_tagged: I'm with the changing to spectators idea, but maybe have the time amount extended a little?

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body: Yeah, I don't like the fact of being completely kicked from the server. It gets rather annoying.

replies.author: Atdit
replies.body: How long do you have to wait until you get kicked?

replies.author: Cynthesis
replies.body: No time at all. You can just get right back on. Fine line between a kick and a tempban.

replies.body: He was asking how long a player has to be idle for the plugin to kick them.

replies.author: Cynthesis
replies.body: Oh, in which case, I'm pretty sure it's only 5 minutes. I'd like to see that extended to at least 10 minutes.

replies.body:
I agree with the idea of it getting extended, however not completely removed.

Before staff applications opened, people would always go AFK in the lobby to gain more online time so that they could apply for a position.
